OLA MK3 box cell

mk3_cell.usdc adapts cad_visual.usdc from the supplied
ola_mk3_openusd_starter.zip. Original hardware design by Nicolás Agustín Méndez
and the Open Lab Automata contributors. The upstream editable CAD and credits
are available in the original repository at the pinned revision below.

https://gitlab.com/open-la/pipettin-bot/-/tree/b3f0c20615c7595e6b2b22d72bb7132a9f409158/models/MK3
Original assembly path: models/MK3/ASSEMBLY.FCStd
Input USD SHA-256: 4997f79bcceffe42cfe52abf1d4698c7db69e4dc2671422c8b7a9fcd831a1114

The CAD-derived asset is under the CERN Open Hardware Licence v2, strongly
reciprocal. See CERN-OHL-S-2.0.txt. Modifications on 2026-11-20 include reduced
mesh tessellation, centered coordinates, updated preview materials and grouping
of the movable visual geometry. The composed scene supplies original
simulation labware, lighting and animation.

The converted geometry credits Wladimir Arturo Garces Carrillo for the 608ZZ
bearing model under Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported. Upstream
modifications are credited to Nicolás Méndez.
https://github.com/FreeCAD/FreeCAD-library/blob/master/Mechanical%20Parts/Bearings/608ZZ_Ball_Bearing.fcstd
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/
